summary: Delegated service account fails to create projects in Service Portal after Okta SSO attribute shape change
description:
Issue summary:
A delegated service account (svc-delegate@redwood) can no longer create new projects in the internal Service Portal UI/API. This started after a routine Okta profile mapping change on 2026-03-09. The service account appears authenticated in Okta but the downstream RBAC check in Service Portal rejects the request claiming 'missing delegated_role' claim.

Impact:
- Internal engineers using automated provisioning flows fail to create project scaffolds (CI/CD onboarding) in us-east production region.
- Occasional manual workaround via admin console is possible but slows onboarding and blocks a small set of urgent infra tasks.
- No external customer impact. Estimated 10-12 engineer-hours of blocked work since 2026-03-10.

Environment:
- Service Portal v2.8.1 (k8s cluster: prod-us-east-portal)
- Auth stack: Okta -> OIDC gateway (authn) -> identity-sync service -> RBAC store
- Affected principal: svc-delegate@redwood (service account using Okta service app)

Steps to reproduce:
1. Use the service account credentials to call POST /api/v1/projects with minimal payload.
2. Observe 403 response with body {"error":"access_denied","reason":"missing delegated_role"}.
3. Inspect JWT issued by OIDC gateway for svc-delegate: delegated_role claim absent.
4. Manually re-run Okta profile mapping for the app; token still lacks claim.

Logs & traces (selected):
- authn-gateway logs (2026-03-10T09:12:07Z): "INFO jwt_issued sub=svc-delegate@redwood claims=[sub,email,groups]"
- identity-sync (2026-03-10T09:12:08Z): "WARN lookup-role: no delegated_role found for principal=svc-delegate@redwood"
- service-portal (2026-03-10T09:12:09Z): "ERROR rbac: denial reason=missing delegated_role request_id=req-78ab3c"

Initial hypothesis:
1) Okta profile mapping was changed to a new expression language (admin UI change recorded 2026-03-09 23:48 UTC) and the delegated_role custom attribute stopped being emitted to the OIDC token for service app scope.
2) identity-sync previously relied on the presence of delegated_role in the token; fallback path was removed in v2.7.0.

Investigation notes:
- Confirmed change in Okta admin audit: "Updated App SAML/OIDC attribute mapping for app=svc-delegate-app by user=j.harper@redwood" on 2026-03-09.
- Replayed token issuance using Okta debug endpoint: tokens issued pre-change contain delegated_role with value "project_creator:basic"; tokens issued after change omit delegated_role key entirely.
- identity-sync code path: sync service expects delegated_role claim under token.claims.attributes.delegated_role; code does not check groups fallback.

Workarounds attempted:
- Re-assigning svc-delegate to an Okta group that maps to project_creator role did not help due to mapping scope restriction on the app.
- Manually creating a temporary RBAC binding for svc-delegate in the RBAC store allowed project creation (mitigates immediate blocking for a few users).

Next steps / action plan:
- Identity team to restore delegated_role mapping for the OIDC app and confirm tokens carry claim (owner: Jacob Harper). Target ETA: 2026-03-12 14:00 UTC.
- Short-term: Expand identity-sync to accept a groups->delegated_role fallback to reduce single-point-of-failure on mapping changes. Create INT follow-up ticket for code change and rollout (owner: Marcus Li).
- Update runbook to include verification steps after Okta mapping changes and add a pre-deploy checklist item.

Attachments & cross-references:
- Slack thread: #internal-it (link: https://slack.redwood.ai/archives/C045IT/thread/p167846)
- Okta audit entry: https://okta.redwood.ai/admin/audit/entries/5934
comments: Aisha Patel (Reporter) - 2026-03-10: Noticed failures coming from the CI onboarding jobs. Created ticket after quick debug showed token missing delegated_role.
SRE Triage (SRE) - 2026-03-10: Reproduced locally. Applied temporary RBAC binding to unblock two onboarding flows. This is scoped to svc-delegate app mapping. See logs attached in description.

Jacob Harper (Identity) - 2026-03-11: Confirmed Okta admin change; I rolled back the mapping in a staging mirror and tokens regained delegated_role. Will coordinate with Okta admins to restore in prod during low traffic window.

Marcus Li (Assignee) - 2026-03-11: I'll prepare a short-term change to identity-sync to accept 'groups' fallback and open a code PR. Also creating follow-up INT to track permanent fix and runbook update.
SRE (2026-03-12): Performed post-rollout checks at 13:45 UTC. Tokens now include delegated_role for svc-delegate. Confirmed project creation via API. Monitoring for 24h before marking resolved.
Aisha Patel (Reporter) - 2026-03-12: Verified CI onboarding jobs succeed. Will close once 24h monitoring completed.
resolution: Pending - rollout completed for claim restoration; monitoring in progress
resolution_notes: Okta mapping restored by Identity team (Jacob Harper) and temporary RBAC binding removed. Service Portal project creation validated via API and CI flows. Follow-up INT created for code fallback: INT-11788. Runbook updated with post-mortem checklist.
follow_up_actions: Update runbook: Okta mapping verification checklist
